claude_proposed_widenings.name: charge_pool_alternative_mode
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Poisoned-removal use expends a fixed 5 charges from the same pool as the variable-cost heal use. Two distinct bonus-action activations share one pool but with different per-activation charge costs. Neither a second ActivatedAbilityMechanics (would declare a separate pool) nor a CastTimeEffectModeChoice (no per-option charge cost) can represent this. Needed: a way to declare alternative activation effects on the same pool with their own fixed charge cost.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: You can also expend 5 Hit Points from the pool of healing power to remove the Poisoned condition from the creature; those points don't also restore Hit Points to the creature.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: range_on_ActivatedAbilityMechanics
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: ActivatedAbilityMechanics has no range field; the tracer hardcodes range: { kind: 'self' } for all class features. Lay on Hands requires Touch range (the paladin must physically touch the creature). The trace labels the attachment 'range Self' which is factually wrong. TriggeredReactionAbilityMechanics and MagicItemSpawnedCreatureMechanics both carry a range field — ActivatedAbilityMechanics should too.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: As a Bonus Action, you can touch a creature (which could be yourself) and draw power from the pool of healing.
